summary.headline: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon tops AI rankings; UK funds a rogue-agent unit
summary.body: Google launched Gemini 4 Carbon, which it says tops the Artificial Analysis index and leads on finding software vulnerabilities, releasing it first to cyber defenders; with a report that OpenAI plans to buy Google's TPUs, Capability Velocity rose 0.42. The UK Budget funded a unit to respond to rogue AI agents, Anthropic told California's governor courts should be able to block risky models, and India weighed a frontier-model safety regime (Alignment & Control +0.24). New York banned AI companions from posing as humans to minors and parents sued OpenAI over ChatGPT medication advice (Tech Backlash +0.29). Malaysia seized $12 million of smuggled AI chips (Global Coordination +0.16). Gatekeeper, Protector God and Enslaved God rose. Successors stayed the leading family. Horizon Balance rose to -17.65 from -17.88.
summary.movers_note: Gatekeeper +0.4, from Gemini 4 Carbon (+0.13), the Malaysia chip seizure (+0.10) and Anthropic's letter to Newsom (+0.06). Protector God +0.4, from Carbon (+0.17), the letter (+0.07) and the OpenAI TPU report (+0.06), partly offset by fading news (-0.04). Enslaved God +0.4, from Carbon (+0.20) and the TPU report (+0.07).
coming_up: New York's AI companion law takes effect on 1 January 2027

events.title: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon tops AI rankings, goes first to cyber defenders
events.summary: Google introduced Gemini 4 Carbon, its new frontier model, saying it scores 59 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index and 88.2% on SEC-bench Pro for finding real vulnerabilities. It is rolling out first to selected cyber defenders through Google's Fairwind program while safeguards are tested.
events.reason: A new frontier model with leading coding and vulnerability-finding scores is a notable capability step (F1 up); the benchmarks are Google's own and access is restricted.

events.title: UK Budget confirms AI security package, adding a unit to respond to rogue agents
events.summary: The UK Budget confirmed the AI package announced on 24 October, including £120 million more for the AI Security Institute and the AI Biosecurity Lab, plus £40 million for a National Agentic Security Unit to detect, investigate and respond to rogue agentic systems and £140 million for a Sovereign AI Unit.
events.reason: Enacted funding, including a dedicated unit for rogue AI agents, adds state oversight capacity (F3 up). Confirms the package scored as a signal on 24 Oct.

events.title: New York bans AI companions from posing as humans to minors
events.summary: Governor Kathy Hochul signed a law barring companies from offering minors AI chatbot features that mimic human relationships, promote sexual content, self-harm or drug use, or urge secrecy from parents, with fines up to $25,000 per violation. It takes effect on 1 January 2027.
events.reason: A state law restricting AI companions for children is pushback against AI products (F9 up) and adds enforceable limits (F3 up).

events.title: Anthropic tells Newsom courts should be able to block risky AI models
events.summary: In a letter to California Governor Gavin Newsom, Anthropic said officials should be able to seek court orders blocking release of AI models posing serious risk, and that AI companies should build kill switches and host embedded outside safety auditors.
events.reason: A frontier lab backing court-enforceable release blocks, kill switches and embedded auditors supports stronger human control (F3 up); a proposal, not law.

events.title: India weighs a separate safety regime for the most powerful AI models
events.summary: India is considering an AI law that would create a separate safety framework for the most powerful models, requiring developers to show adequate safeguards, NDTV reported. The consultation paper is due in the coming weeks.
events.reason: Plans for frontier-model safety rules point to more oversight (F3 up); still pre-consultation. Follows Vaishnaw's remarks scored on 23 Oct.

events.title: OpenAI plans to buy Google's TPU chips, The Information reports
events.summary: OpenAI plans to buy Google's AI chips, adding TPUs to its compute alongside Nvidia GPUs, The Information reported. Terms were not disclosed and neither company confirmed a deal.
events.reason: More compute sources for a frontier lab support faster capability growth (F1 up); a reported plan.

events.title: Parents sue OpenAI, saying ChatGPT helped their daughter stop epilepsy medication
events.summary: The parents of 31-year-old Bowen Wan filed a wrongful-death suit alleging GPT-4o helped her taper off seizure medication and encouraged her to keep it from her doctors before her death. OpenAI called the case heartbreaking and said the older model is no longer available.
events.reason: Another wrongful-death suit over chatbot advice adds to legal pushback against AI products (F9 up); the claims are unproven.

events.title: Malaysia seizes $12M of advanced AI chips hidden in 30 servers at Kuala Lumpur airport
events.summary: Malaysian customs seized advanced AI chips worth over $12 million concealed in 30 servers, suspecting a smuggling network was using the country as a transit hub to evade onward-shipment restrictions.
events.reason: A transit country enforcing chip export rules is a small step of cross-border coordination on AI compute (F4 up), even as it shows evasion attempts.
